headlines.title: Iran sets steep demands to reopen Hormuz despite hopes Oman deal could break impasse
headlines.description: Tehran has vowed not to reopen the shipping lane “until America corrects its behavior,” despite a looming agreement with Oman.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Israel rejects Trump’s Gaza plan, Todd Blanche confirmed as attorney general, and a boat capsizes in the New York Harbor.

headlines.title: Boat captain arrested after vessel capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing woman and her 5-month-old baby
headlines.description: The captain was charged with reckless endangerment, officials said.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed says he spoke with Obama after primary win, hopes he’ll campaign for him
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed says he “really enjoyed” his recent conversation with former President Barack Obama and hopes he’ll campaign with him ahead of the general election.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Jim Banks says GOP Rep. Max Miller should resign if ‘allegations are true’: Full interview
headlines.description: Sen. Jim Banks (R-Ind.) tells Meet the Press that Rep. Max Miller (R-Ohio) should resign from Congress and end his re-election bid "if the allegations are true" about domestic abuse.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez says she hasn’t ruled out a potential run for president or Senate in 2028
headlines.description: The New York representative said “anything is possible at this juncture” when asked whether she’d thought about running for Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s seat.

headlines.title: ‘Highlander’ star Christopher Lambert leaves Pittsburgh fan convention early after health scare
headlines.description: “Highlander” star Christopher Lambert left Pennsylvania’s largest comic-con early after reportedly collapsing at the event on Saturday.

headlines.title: Sen. Jim Banks says Rep. Max Miller should drop his re-election bid if allegations are true
headlines.description: The Indiana Republican is the latest GOP lawmaker to call on Miller, R-Ohio, to step aside in the wake of domestic violence allegations, which he has denied.

headlines.title: Indian national arrested in Germany, charged with murder of Arizona girlfriend
headlines.description: Varun Batchigari, 20, was arrested at an airport after, police believe, he fled the country.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed says he hopes to campaign with Obama after ‘warm and inspiring’ call
headlines.description: Top Democrats, including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer, have lined up behind El-Sayed after supporting his rival in the primary.
